Name: CA. Suyog Upadhyaya
Question: I'm 26 and in first year of my CA articleship, Am I too late? Will I face problems after CA because of my age? Or is it okay?
Answer: Multiply your current age by 2, and you are still not late: She is Saroja Ramachandran. She completed her CA course at the age of 59, which is more than 26 multiplied by 2. Will you face problems? You will certainly face students in their late teens or early twenties in your office, will that be a problem, certainly not! You can use your age, experience and maturity while dealing with a client. I believe that it is an advantage rather than a short-coming. In our GMCS class, there was a ma’am who had a beautiful daughter and a son. We all looked at her with respect. We all learned new things from her, and as per her experience , she learnt a lot of new things from young minds, like new age technology etc. and we , the younger ones learnt how to deal with life situations from her experiences that she shared. There was another sir, who was lecturer in college, who attended our MCS course. He was in his articleship and was loving the process of learning and making connections. Long answer short: It is perfectly ok! Just make sure that you take advantage of your age and experiences. Best wishes.

Name: CA. Suyog Upadhyaya
Question: How do I stay fit as I get older?
Answer: By doing what exactly these Octogenarians do: Ernestine Shepherd Wang De-Shun (Both picture source : The Independent, UK) So what are their backgrounds? Ernestine was a school receptionist while Wang De-shun was a theatre artist. They both didn’t start working out until their mid fifties. So whether you’re in your 10’s , 20’s , 30’s , 40’s, 50’s …. 90’s … there’s no time limit for starting out! What did they do? Taking control over diet & their physical activity is the key component. While Ernestine eats raw eggs (inspired from Rocky) , Wang eats whatever he wants. It is important to note that, Wang works out almost 4 hours per day. (Sylvester Stallone) How can we start? First of all, we have to take control of our lifestyle. Choosing a fad diet, which you’re not comfortable in will certainly lead to failure. We have to choose something that we can stick to , for a long term! Generally, we should start our exercise with beginner’s level for 10–20 minutes a day and gradually progressing over time to about 45 minutes (personal experience, will be different for different individuals). If you need beginner’s program, I have one mentioned in my bio. It is completely for free :-) What are my inputs? 3. Sleep & Rest is very important : Have proper rest days and a good sleep. Amount of sleep varies from person to person. I prefer sleeping about 6 hours a day. Check what works for you! 4. Meditation & Breathing exercises: Meditation helps keeping our mind calm and composed. You can just start my observing your breath, thoughts will come , don’t try to shoo away the thoughts, rather observe the nature, the root cause. I practice Vipassanā meditation everyday. For breathing exercise, you can check Wim Hof breathing in Youtube. 5. We are in this for long term : There will be good days there will be more bad days. We just have to stick with our routine. Choosing what works for you effortlessly is the key. And always BELIEVE IN SELF! Thank you very much for reading this. Wishing you a good health and a good life!

Name: CA. Suyog Upadhyaya
Question: What are things you should never do or tell your co-workers?
Answer: One simple advice is not to mix work with personal life. I have had bittersweet memories of my coworkers when I used to work for a big audit firm. There are a couple of guys whom I still talk with and they have been some of the best people I’ve ever come across. But due consideration should be taken in the following: 1.Office romance: (Image Credit: Shutterstock) It usually ends with a lot of gossips and you don’t know when the relationship might turn sour and one of the people have to leave the place. Have seen many real life incidents. Exception: When you’re running a business with your partner. 2.Your intention to quit the job Office politics is real. The friend you trusted, guess what, the manager took him/her out to lunch/dinner and they spilled it all. It’s better that you keep it to yourself and have a smooth sail. (Yes, pretty much the same) 3. Your personal life It’s always better to keep your personal life away from your co-workers. No need to talk about your relationships/ your spouse etc. It includes your personal views about religion/politics etc. Its just not worth it. You came to office for work, do that and leave home! 4. Office gossips/politics: Yes, there are times the manager or the boss did something that was very rude or completely irrational. Keep it to yourself. Bitching about your boss to the co-worker might end up like in Point no. 2 Don’t believe things you hear about a certain colleague. Human Relation is dynamic, its very different with different individuals. There was a time, I had to work on-site with a new colleague. Everyone told how an egomaniac he was. Turned out he was one of the coolest dude I’ve met. We still talk till this date. (Image credit: Amazon) These are the things that I have experienced. Some are my own whilst others, I have observed with other co-workers. Keep in mind that these might not apply to you, since workplace and the dynamics can be very different. Let me know in the comments, what did you resonate with the most or something that you had experienced and would like to add. Wishing you good health and a good life.
